input.summary: Add Licensor IP/misconduct indemnity in Article XII and narrow the Licensee indemnity to Licensee content and breach of law
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs one way only, and Article XIII expressly disclaims any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we have no protection if the Licensed Technology infringes a third party's rights. We have added a reciprocal Licensor defence and indemnity for third-party IP, breach of law, data-breach and wilful misconduct claims (with standard notice, control and cooperation mechanics) and narrowed our indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our own breach of law; we can discuss usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations and specifications) and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies if helpful.

ops.text: Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its affiliates, directors, officers, employees and agents from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting suits, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) any allegation that the Licensed Technology, Documentation or any deliverable or service provided by Licensor infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (iv) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or obligation on the indemnified party shall be made without its prior written consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense. Licensor's obligations under this Article XII shall apply notwithstanding, and shall not be subject to the exclusions or limitations of liability set forth in, Article XIII.
